For each seed and condition, q = 0.5 tim: For each seed and condition, q = 0.5 times EVM improvement plus 0.5 times worse-side output ACLR improvement, relative to the common baseline. For every configuration use the same ref: For every configuration use the same reference costs: FoM = mean(q) - 5 log10(P/1000) - 5 log10(OPs/2000).
